text: The Riesz representation theorem (for Hilbert spaces) says: every bounded linear functional φ on a Hilbert space H has the form φ(v) =
choices: Tv for a bounded operator T
explanation: Riesz: φ∈H* ↔ ∃! w∈H: φ(v)=⟨v,w⟩ for all v. This gives the canonical isomorphism H≅H*. Combined with the Lax-Milgram theorem, it underlies much of PDE theory.
